chunks: ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, from Khālid ibn Najīḥ, from Zurārah ibn Aʿyan, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “The boy must inevitably have a ghaybah (occultation).”

I said, “And why?” He عليه السلام said: “He will fear,” and he gestured with his hand toward his belly. “And he is al-Muntaẓar, and he is the one concerning whose birth people will doubt. So among them are those who will say: ‘A pregnancy’; and among them are those who will say: ‘His father died and left no successor’; and among them are those who will say: ‘He was born two years before his father’s death.’”
Zurārah said: So I said, “What do you command me to do if I reach that time?” He عليه السلام said: “Supplicate to Allah with this duʿāʾ:”

O Allah, make me know Yourself, for if You do not make me know Yourself, I will not know You. O Allah, make me know Your Prophet, for if You do not make me know Your Prophet, I will never know him. O Allah, make me know Your Ḥujjah, for if You do not make me know Your Ḥujjah, I will go astray from my religion.
Aḥmad ibn al-Hilāl said: “I heard this hadith fifty-six years ago.”

key_terms.ادْعُ: supplicate; invoke Allah with the taught prayer
key_terms.الْغُلَامِ: the boy; a reference to the awaited Imam
key_terms.حُجَّتَكَ: Your divine proof; Allah’s authoritative representative
key_terms.دِينِي: my religion, from which one may stray without right recognition
key_terms.غَيْبَةٍ: occultation; a period of concealed presence
key_terms.نَبِيَّكَ: Your Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.وِلَادَتِهِ: his birth, about which people will dispute

ai.seo_question: What duʿāʾ did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teach for remaining guided during the ghaybah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the promised boy will necessarily enter ghaybah (occultation), and that people will differ and doubt the circumstances of his birth and succession. It also teaches a foundational duʿāʾ for times of confusion, asking Allah to grant recognition of Himself, His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and His Ḥujjah so that one does not go astray from the religion.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Hilal who said, ‘Usman Bin Isa narrated to us, from Khalid Bin Najeeh, from Zurara Bin Ayn who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘An Occultation is inevitable for the boy’.

I said, ‘And why (is that so)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> would fear’, and he<sup>asws</sup> gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> hand towards his<sup>asws</sup> belly, ‘and he<sup>asws</sup> is the awaited, and he<sup>asws</sup> is the one the people would doubt regarding his<sup>asws</sup> birth. So, from them would be one who would be saying, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was borne’; and from them would be one who would be saying, ‘His<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> passed away and did not leave a replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup>)’; and from them would be one who would be saying, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was born two years before his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> passed away’’.

Zurara said, ‘So I said, ‘And what would you<sup>asws</sup> instruct me with if I were to come across that time period?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Supplicate to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with this supplication,

‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Acquaint Yourself<sup>azwj</sup> to me, for if You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Acquaint Yourself<sup>saww</sup> to me, I will not (be able to) recognise You<sup>azwj</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, for if You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, I would not recognise Your<sup>azwj</sup> Divine Authority. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Divine Authority, for it You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Divine Authority, I would stray from my Religion’’.
Ahmad Bin Hilal (the narrator) said, ‘I heard this Hadeeth fifty six years ago’.
en.sarwar: 29. Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad has narrated from from Ahmad ibn Hilal who has said that ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa narrated to us from Khalid ibn Najih from Zurara ibn A‘yan that abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) has said the following.
“It will be necessary for the young boy to diappear from the public sight.”

I then asked, “Why it will be necessary?” He said, “Because he will have fear- he then pointed towards his midsection. He will be the one whose reappearance will be intensely expected. It will be he in whose being born people will have doubts. Certain people will say, “His mother has just conceived him.” Others will say, “His father died but left no surviving son.” Certain others will say, “He was born two years before the death of his father.”
Zurara has said, “I said to him, ‘What do you command me if will attain that time?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Pray to Allah in the following words.

“O Lord, make me know You for if you would not make me know You I will not know You. O Lord, make me know Your prophet, for if You would not make me know your Messenger I will never know him. O Lord, make me know the one who possesses Your authority over the creatures for if You will not make me know him I will stray away from my religion.”
Ahmad ibn Hilal has said, “I had heard this hadith fifty six years ago.”
